transcript: It is honestly criminal that this was not filmed, because the 30 Rock 20th anniversary show at Radio City Musical was one of the greatest things I have ever witnessed with my own two eyes. They really tried to temper our expectations right at the top, telling us it was gonna be super messy. They didn't have any rehearsal, but honestly, besides the occasional mic issue, the event pretty much went off without a hitch. And I really have to hand it to them, because I think that there is a version of this event where they just have the main five cast members sitting in chairs answering questions from a moderator. But instead, they went all out with musical performances, celebrity cameos. Like, at one point, Tom Hanks showed up because why not? They also did a full Jenna Maroney medley, including Will Forte in full Jesus Drag. They did a dating game show segment with three of Liz's exes. There was a segment with Chris Parnell as Doctor Spaceman. Alec Baldwin did a bit where he gave Jack Donaghy's perspective on a bunch of world events that have happened since the ending of 30 Rock, which ended with the reveal that the entire cast is in the Epstein files. There was just something so surreal about seeing the cast deliver 30 Rock jokes in 2026 and kind of proved that you could do a 30 Rock reboot today and it would still be just as funny as it was In its prime. And then the event ended with a big musical medley, including Jeff Richmond and Erika Henningson singing Cleveland, which they separately credited for inspiring Taylor Swift's new song Lin Manuel Miranda came out and sang Werewolf Bar Mitzvah because there is truly nowhere that that man will not show up. And finally, Jane Krakowski came out and brought us home with rural juror, the song that also closed out the series. The entire show was clearly such a labor of love for everyone involved. It was the perfect love letter to 30 Rock, and I can't believe that I got to be in the room for it.
